title: Cinematic whoosh fast transition
description: "Cinematic whoosh fast transition" (Mixkit SFX #1492). Short bright whoosh that swells and peaks near its end (1.3 s) - a 'whoosh-in' into a cut. Measured: 1.33 s, RMS -21.0 dBFS, -13.0 LUFS, onset 0.22 s, loudest at 1.08 s, audible to 1.29 s, brightness centroid 4190 Hz.
suggested_use: Align its peak (~1.08 s) to a scene cut or a card snapping into place.
judged_by: title/tags on the source page plus measured spectrogram and loudness envelope (not auditioned by ear)
